items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.summary: agent-browser 是 Vercel Labs 推出的基于 Rust 开发的浏览器自动化 CLI，专为 AI 智能体设计，其核心机制是通过 `snapshot` 命令将页面解析为紧凑文本并赋予元素引用（如 @e1），使智能体能以单条 Shell 命令逐步驱动浏览器。该工具默认使用 Chrome for Testing 引擎，支持通过 CDP 协议连接本地或云浏览器（如 Browserbase），并提供 `agent-browser skills get core` 命令向 AI 智能体注入与其版本匹配的操作指南，实现精准的元素交互与状态检查。
items.why_now: Vercel Labs 刚发布 agent-browser，为 AI 智能体提供原生 Rust 驱动的浏览器自动化 CLI 工具。
items.why_now_en: Vercel's Rust CLI turns browser testing into agent-friendly shell commands.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.summary: Google 发布 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，支持原生 15 秒视频生成，价格降至 720p 下每秒 0.07 美元，较 1.1 版本降低 30%。该模型通过增强参考遵循和多轮对话编辑能力，确保 360 度转场中角色与产品的一致性，并支持从 3 到 15 秒的灵活时长控制。新增的自然语音生成功能实现了清晰的角色对口型和多说话人条件化，适用于广告变体制作和虚拟试穿场景。
items.why_now: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 刚降价 30% 至 0.07 美元/秒，独立开发者可即刻低成本产出 15 秒高保真视频。

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.summary: vercel-labs/agent-desktop 是一款基于操作系统无障碍树（Accessibility Tree）的 AI 代理桌面操作 CLI 工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，通过返回包含唯一引用（ref）的 JSON 快照，让代理无需依赖截图或像素匹配即可执行点击与输入操作。该工具以无模型为核心设计，支持通过 npm、Homebrew 安装，其 ref 机制具备版本绑定特性，需在处理 STALE_REF 或 AMBIGUOUS_TARGET 错误时重新生成快照以更新操作目标。

items.title: ConardLi/garden-skills
items.summary: ConardLi 开源的 garden-skills 项目提供了一套面向 Claude Code、Cursor 及 Codex 等 AI 编码智能体的生产级技能集合，核心功能涵盖网页设计、本地知识检索、GPT-Image-2 图像生成及视频演示制作。其中 motion-showreel 技能通过确定性渲染管道支持生成 5-60 秒甚至长达 20 分钟的 MP4 视频，内置 43 种风格库（如瑞士编辑、水墨、合成波等）并具备独立的音频/画面时间轴与 TTS 配音功能；web-video-presentation 技能则能将脚本或文章转化为可录屏的 Vite + React + TypeScript 16:9 网页演示，实现从内容创作到视觉产出的自动化流程。
items.why_now: Claude Code等主流Agent生态开放Skills扩展机制，该开源合集已上线提供生产级能力。

items.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summary: Ramp 数据显示，尽管 AI 使用量持续上升，但代币支出在 8 月至 9 月仅微增 1.5%，较 7 月的 42% 增速大幅放缓，主因是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 陷入价格战导致企业获客成本降低而收入封顶。Anthropic 为 Fable 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 的降价举措直接削减了约 6 亿美元收入增长，同时 Meta、Nvidia 及新兴工具 Jev 的低价或开源方案进一步加剧了竞争。头部 1% 企业的人均月度支出从峰值跌破 10,000 美元，且中位数企业仅支出 12-15 美元，显示 AI 市场正从超高增长转向买方市场，单纯依靠补贴锁定客户策略在多元竞争环境下失效。
items.summary_en: Ramp data reveals that corporate AI spending flatlined in August and September with token spend growth falling from 42% to just 1.5%, despite rising usage volumes and Anthropic approaching its IPO. This revenue stall is driven by a buyer's market where price cuts by OpenAI and Anthropic—such as halving GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna API prices and reducing Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 costs, which slashed one company's revenue growth by $600 million—coupled with low-cost competitors like Meta, Nvidia, and Jev, are capping income from venture-backed clients. Although October saw a slight re-acceleration with an 8.9% increase in token spend, the top 1% of high-growth firms, which previously spent $10,000 per employee, have seen spending drop, indicating that intense competition is preventing monetization of increased AI adoption.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks 正洽谈以 5 亿美元现金加里程碑付款收购 3 年历史的初创公司 Clutch Security，该公司专注于保护 AI 代理对公司系统的访问权限。Clutch 去年 1 月由 Lightspeed 领投完成 2000 万美元 A 轮融资，当时估值 8500 万美元，目前年化经常性收入（ARR）接近 1000 万美元，此次收购估值约为 ARR 的 50 倍。
items.summary_en: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security, an AI agent security startup with ~$10M in ARR, for $500M in cash plus milestone payouts, valuing it at 50x ARR. This would be Palo Alto Networks' seventh acquisition this year, joining deals like Console ($500M), Chronosphere ($2.95B), and Koi ($231M), reflecting a broader industry trend of acquiring AI security firms to combat rising AI-driven cyberattacks.

items.title: 马斯克官宣 Cybertruck 停产：销量不足预期一成；李飞飞团队推出世界模型「模拟掌机」；小米汽车成立国际事业部｜极客早知道
items.summary: 特斯拉宣布明年年中逐步停产 Cybertruck 以腾出产能给 Cybercab，因该车型今年三季度交付量约 7000-8000 辆，年销量预估仅 3 万辆，仅为原 25 万辆规划目标的 12%；李飞飞团队 World Labs 推出基于 Atlas 模型的网页端演示“Frameboy”，允许用户通过云 GPU 以最高 15 帧/秒实时探索 AI 生成的多模态世界；小米汽车正式成立国际业务部，由副总裁于立国兼任总经理，计划于 2027 年下半年首站进入欧洲市场。
items.summary_en: Tesla is phasing out the Cybertruck by mid-2026 to allocate capacity for the Cybercab, after the truck's annual sales of approximately 30,000 units fell to just 12% of the original 250,000-unit target. Meanwhile, OpenAI completed a $11 billion first-round funding tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation, and Li Fei-Fei’s World Labs launched "Frameboy," a web-based demo allowing real-time exploration of AI-generated multimodal worlds at up to 15 frames per second.

items.title: 估值 400 亿美元，美国公司，终于做出了中国开源模型的竞对
items.summary: OpenAI 前 CTO Mira Murati 创立的 Thinking Machines Lab 发布 594B 参数量的开源模型 Inkling 2 Small，公司同日宣布以 400 亿美元投前估值融资 50 亿美元，该模型在知识工作与长流程商业任务中表现优于 Claude Sonnet 5.5 等闭源模型，且单任务成本仅 1.18 美元。该模型训练后半程明确采样自中国厂商月之暗面的开放权重模型 Kimi K3 轨迹，主要面向云端微调平台 Tinker，通过强化学习重点提升编程（占比 65%）与智能体工作能力，旨在通过开源模型引流企业客户进行付费微调。
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab, valued at $40 billion, released its 594B-parameter MoE model Inkling 2 Small, which achieved a 1527 Elo score on AA-Briefcase—surpassing Claude Sonnet 5.5—by utilizing agent trajectories sampled from Moonshot AI's open-source Kimi K3. The model features a 1M context window and excels at long-horizon autonomous tasks like coding and 3D generation, while its low pricing ($0.30/$1.00 per million tokens) and "tinkerability" are strategically designed to drive adoption of TML's paid cloud fine-tuning API, Tinker.

items.title: I made two free AI models review each other's code in one Switch room.
items.summary: 该工具基于Switch Console、OpenCode及Mattermost构建，利用DeepSeek和GLM两个免费模型在同一聊天室中互审代码并相互质询，由人工裁决优劣，全程无需付费API密钥即可运行。测试显示模型对同一代码片段（如Java除零错误）的判断具有随机性，且当Reviewer B先阅读Reviewer A的评审时，双方结论高度重叠，因此当前方案更适合作为可见的交叉检查机制，未来需通过隔离评审顺序来增强其独立性。
items.why_now: 该方案依托OpenCode及免费模型，无需付费API即可运行双AI交叉审代码。
items.why_now_en: Switch Console free layer enables zero-cost multi-agent setups.
items.summary_en: Code Review Duel uses OpenCode to pit two free AI models, DeepSeek and GLM, against each other for collaborative code review within a shared Switch Console room. The system enables both models to examine identical code snippets, critique each other's analyses, and present their findings to a human for a final decision, eliminating the need for paid API keys. This setup facilitates a transparent cross-checking process where model disagreements—such as distinguishing between compile errors and runtime exceptions—are surfaced, though the shared context causes review overlap that independent sequential reviews would reduce.

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.summary: Worktrunk 是一款针对并行 AI 代理工作流设计的 Git worktree 管理 CLI，通过简化的命令将 worktree 操作体验提升至与分支管理同等便捷的水平。它提供包括自动创建 Claude 环境、Copy-on-Write 构建缓存共享及流式 CI 状态预览在内的核心功能，支持在 macOS、Linux 及 Windows 上通过 Homebrew、Cargo 或 Winget 等渠道安装部署。
items.why_now: Worktrunk刚发布，解决并行运行5-10+个AI Agent时的Git工作树管理痛点。
items.why_now_en: It’s the most popular git worktree manager for parallel AI agents.
items.summary_en: Worktrunk is a CLI tool that simplifies Git worktree management for running 5-10+ parallel AI agents like Claude Code and Codex by streamlining directory creation and cleanup. It replaces clunky native Git commands with three core operations and includes quality-of-life features such as copy-on-write build caches, hooks for workflow automation, and LLM-generated commit messages. The tool is installable across macOS, Linux, Windows, and Arch Linux via Homebrew, Cargo, or Winget, allowing users to manage parallel development environments with syntax as simple as standard branch switching.

items.title: A Jev that can ask Opus for help gives Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost
items.why_now: Jev+Opus混合模型刚验证可行，以1/4成本实现顶级准确率，开启身份解析降本新窗口。
items.why_now_en: Jev + Opus hybrid hits frontier accuracy at 4x lower cost.
items.summary_en: A hybrid model combining Jev and Opus achieves frontier-grade accuracy for identity resolution grading at over 4x lower costs than using Opus alone, while decision models like Jev and Luna offer up to 90x cost savings and 10x speed advantages out of the box. Although decision models trail Opus by 6 percentage points on harder benchmarks, Jev’s superior confidence calibration enables it to outperform Luna in hybrid setups, making LLM-assisted grading a viable alternative to slow manual human review.

items.title: Show HN: AJX – Find out where AI agents get stuck using your product
items.summary_en: AJX (Agent Journey Experience) is a CLI tool that tests product usability from an AI agent's perspective by running an outer harness loop to execute an inner agent (e.g., Claude, Codex) against specific tasks, then analyzing logs for retries, token consumption, and errors. The tool generates a detailed report and actionable "asks"—such as missing JSON flags or documentation mismatches—to improve agentic usability and reduce friction. Designed to integrate into CI/CD pipelines, AJX helps developers ensure their CLIs, SDKs, and docs are agent-friendly by identifying bottlenecks that waste agent time and resources.

items.title: An inside look at Anthropic’s AI speedup
items.summary: 评估机构METR基于11周内部数据估算，Anthropic的AI研发进度已提升至2024-25年基准的1.3至3倍，其中约80%的加速归功于自身AI驱动，且内部披露了性能优于Claude Opus 5.5的“Model 4”等未公开模型。Anthropic在IPO文件中将“归因于AI的显著加速进展”定义为危险阈值，报告指出该临界点可能已临近，目前尚未发现明显的技术瓶颈限制该自动化循环的进一步提速。
items.why_now: METR刚证实Anthropic内部进度提速且IPO临近，安全阈值逼近，窗口正在关闭。
items.why_now_en: METR confirms Anthropic's AI development speed is doubling with no bottlenecks.
items.summary_en: METR estimates that Anthropic’s internal AI progress has accelerated to roughly 2x its previous pace, driven 80% by its own models and unimpeded by clear bottlenecks. The report identified two unreleased internal models ahead of Claude Opus 5.5, notably a “Model 4” that achieved a 50% score on all 15 tested benchmarks, raising concerns that the lab is nearing its defined threshold for "dramatically accelerated progress attributable to AI."

items.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
items.summary: 微软开源了前沿语音 AI 模型家族 VibeVoice，其中 ASR-7B 模型支持 60 分钟长音频的单次处理及 50 多种语言识别，并推出了 VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet 引擎，通过异构量化技术将模型从 4.62 GB 压缩至 1.58 GB，实现在无 GPU 的 3 核 CPU 上保持实时推理（RTF < 1）。其核心创新在于采用 7.5 Hz 超低帧率的连续语音分词器与下一词扩散框架，结合 LLM 与扩散头，在提升计算效率的同时保持了高保真音频输出。
items.why_now: 微软开源VibeVoice-TTS因滥用被下架，但实时模型与流式ASR刚发布，窗口期仅剩ASR。
items.why_now_en: CPU-only ASR just released, no GPU needed.
items.summary_en: Microsoft open-sourced the VibeVoice-ASR family, featuring a 7B model capable of transcribing 60-minute multilingual audio in a single pass with structured output for speakers, timestamps, and content. The suite includes VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet, a CPU inference engine that compresses the model from 4.62 GB to 1.58 GB using heterogeneous quantization to achieve real-time processing without a GPU, and VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming, which supports continuous transcription across 10 languages with custom hotwords. Core models utilize continuous speech tokenizers at a 7.5 Hz frame rate within a next-token diffusion framework, while Microsoft has since removed the VibeVoice-TTS code from the repository following misuse.

items.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
items.why_now: Underdog刚开放32MB语音模型下载，本地端侧AI交互窗口已开启。
items.why_now_en: Woof speech model just dropped free for edge devices.
items.summary_en: Underdog has released "Woof," a 32MB, 31-million-parameter open-source speech generation model that enables fully offline voice interaction in browser-based demos. This follows the startup's launch of "Bark," a 167MB edge-optimized speech-to-text model, alongside a 27-billion-parameter laptop-compatible model and a waitlisted app positioned as a locally hosted alternative to cloud-based tools like Muse and Instinct.

items.title: Artificial Analysis 实测 GPT Image 2.6 图像生成与编辑表现
I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.why_now: Tau 刚在旧金山推出人形机器人上门服务，正通过“付费扫楼”廉价换取清洗数据，以加速其全自动AI模型的落地。
items.why_now_en: Tau's $30/hour pilot program is a live data-collection window for autonomous cleaning.
items.summary_en: Tau Robotics, a San Francisco startup, operates a remote-piloted humanoid robot cleaning service that charges between $30 and $100 per session while collecting real-world data to train its AI for eventual autonomy. The 4.5-foot robots utilize 3D-printed claw hands and kinematic guidance for complex tasks like laundry folding, though they currently struggle with basic navigation like climbing stairs, distinguishing them as closer to radio-controlled devices than fully autonomous systems.

items.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
items.why_now: Artex转向闭源，但现存公开代码副本仍可被用于发起网络攻击。
items.why_now_en: Artex is going closed-source now, but hundreds of public copies remain accessible for active attacks.
items.summary_en: Censys discovered over 800 unauthenticated, publicly accessible deployments of Artex, a Chinese-made open-source autonomous AI penetration testing tool that can execute cyberattacks from reconnaissance to data exfiltration with minimal human interaction. The exposure has facilitated broad-scale attacks, including compromises of the Korean finance sector and Microsoft cloud customers via ConnectWise, often by exploiting simple vulnerabilities like weak passwords and lack of multi-factor authentication. Although Artex has since transitioned to a closed-source model, existing code copies remain available on public code-sharing sites, posing ongoing security risks.

items.title: Engineering Low-Light Video Diffusion: Spatial Identity Preservation in Club Spotlight AI
After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
items.summary: 亚马逊正式推出短信版Alexa AI代理，允许用户在假日购物季前通过自然语言完成搜索、加购、下单及订单查询，并支持发送图片搜索相似商品。此举是在亚马逊9月份封禁Meta的Muse访问其站点后推出的替代方案，未来Alexa将基于用户偏好进行个性化推荐。目前该功能向部分美国用户推送激活短信，未获邀请的用户可加入等待列表，预计未来几周将扩大开放范围。
items.summary_en: Amazon is launching a text-based Alexa shopping agent for select U.S. customers, enabling natural language searches, cart management, and image-based discovery ahead of the holiday season. This rollout follows Amazon blocking Meta’s Muse in September and positions the platform alongside other competitors like DoorDash, which is developing its own text-based agent in response to the growing consumer AI agent market.

items.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
items.summary: Physicl 完成由 Inovia Capital 领投的 1000 万美元种子轮融资，利用前公司 nfinite 积累的 3D 渲染技术栈，为机器人物理 AI 模型提供高保真仿真环境以解决训练数据痛点。其核心产品 Studio 包含 10,000 个 3D 环境和 100,000 个资产，通过生成合成数据帮助模型处理阴影遮挡等边缘案例，并支持基于 AI 代理工作流将非结构化数据转化为高质量 3D 表示，目前已与 SpAItial 合作用于提升其 Echo-3 模型的仿真保真度。
items.summary_en: Physicl raised $10 million in seed funding led by Inovia Capital to develop high-fidelity simulation environments for physical AI and robotics training. The startup launched its Studio product, which includes 10,000 3D environments and 100,000 assets, enabling users to generate synthetic data for post-training on edge cases like object discernment in cluttered or shadowed scenes. Co-founder Alex de Vigan repurposed the 3D rendering technology from his previous company, nfinite, to address the limitations of generative AI in spatial manipulation, allowing customers like SpAItial to convert unstructured real-world data into physics-accurate training sets that support automated, on-the-fly data generation.

items.title: Bloomberg：OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元融资首批到账，估值达 1.25 万亿美元
items.summary: OpenAI 完成总额最高 200 亿美元的融资轮，投资者已向首批 110 亿美元打款，使其估值达到 1.25 万亿美元。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has secured its first tranche of $11 billion in new funding at a valuation of $1.25 trillion, with investors already transferring the funds. The remaining portion of the round, totaling up to an additional $20 billion, is expected to be finalized within a few weeks.

items.title: 更高能效比，带来新惊喜：M6 款 MacBook Pro 初探
items.summary: 搭载 M6 芯片的 MacBook Pro 在 CPU、GPU 核心数及内存带宽上全面升级，实测运行 Gemma 4 12B 本地模型时 token 生成速度达每秒 19 个，且 32GB 统一内存架构成功支撑 Qwen3.8 27B 模型的加载与运行，显著优于 M5 版；在 Whispers Transcription 语音转文字、Topaz Photo 图像处理及 DaVinci Resolve 视频渲染等重度场景中，M6 版耗时分别缩短至 24 秒、10 秒及 59 分钟，能效比优势明显，基础款因 SoC 升级而凸显高性价比，适合追求性能平衡的用户将预算向内存和硬盘倾斜。
items.summary_en: The M6 MacBook Pro features a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU with enhanced memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, achieving roughly 10-20% CPU speedups and significant NPU improvements over the M5. Real-world testing demonstrates substantial performance gains for AI and creative tasks, such as rendering DaVinci Resolve projects in 59 minutes versus 76 minutes on the M5, and transcribing audio in 24 seconds compared to 41 seconds. The increased 32GB base memory allows local execution of larger models like Qwen3.8 27B, making the base model a more competitive option for users seeking strong AI and video editing capabilities without upgrading to high-end Pro or Max chips.

items.title: A Self-Improving AI System for a Gas Compressor Fleet in Saudi Arabia
items.summary: 该系统专为沙特阿拉伯大型天然气处理商定制，通过GLM 5.3开源模型在本地数据中心运行，利用CodeNinja on device AI堆栈实现边缘计算，确保所有数据主权留在境内。其核心机制是在每个工单关闭时将预测与实际情况对比写入记忆层，从而在不重新训练模型权重的情况下持续优化维护决策，取代了传统工程师手工读取数据的方式。该系统通过条件、间隔和结果三个命名代理协同工作，由人工进行最终确认，并基于2026年行业案例显示，采用“延长检查”策略可将特定机组的检查间隔延长20%至34%。

items.title: Inside GitHub's new Git storage architecture
items.summary_en: GitHub’s new Git storage architecture supports 5,000 concurrent agents and 7,200 pushes per second on a single repository by decoupling storage from compute and minimizing coordination. This design leverages the fact that only immutable Git object references require ordering, enabling infrastructure components to scale independently while maintaining standard Git functionality for hundreds of millions of developers.

directions.name: AgentOps 浏览器行为审计仪表盘
directions.description: 通过拦截 agent-browser 的 CDP 流量，为 AI 智能体的浏览器操作生成可视化执行轨迹、异常检测及成本分析报告。
directions.description_en: Intercepts CDP traffic from agent-browser to generate visual execution trails, anomaly detection, and cost analysis reports for AI agents.
directions.target_user: 部署 AI 智能体进行网页自动化、QA 或数据采集的开发者与企业技术负责人
directions.target_user_en: Developers and tech leads deploying AI agents for web automation, QA, or data scraping
core_features: 实时捕获 agent-browser 发出的 CDP 指令序列，生成可回放的操作轨迹视频
基于 LLM 对操作日志进行语义分析，标记异常循环、死锁或敏感数据泄露风险
计算每次浏览器会话的 API 调用成本和 Token 消耗，输出优化建议
core_features_en: Capture real-time CDP command sequences from agent-browser to generate replayable operation trail videos
Semantic analysis of operation logs using LLM to flag anomalous loops, deadlocks, or sensitive data leakage risks
Calculate API call costs and token consumption per browser session, providing optimization recommendations
directions.why_now: Vercel Labs 推出的 agent-browser 在 GitHub Trending 上获得高评分（9/10），其核心机制是通过 CDP 协议驱动浏览器。然而，社区讨论中开发者普遍反映 AI 智能体在复杂网页环境中容易出现不可预测的行为（如陷入死循环、误操作敏感区域），且缺乏有效的调试手段。agent-browser 提供了底层 CDP 接口，但目前缺乏上层可视化和审计工具，现在是切入“智能体运维”（AgentOps）利基市场的最佳时机。
directions.why_now_en: Vercel Labs' agent-browser is trending on GitHub with a high score (9/10), utilizing the CDP protocol to drive browsers. However, community discussions reveal that developers widely report AI agents exhibiting unpredictable behaviors in complex web environments (e.g., infinite loops, sensitive area misuse) with limited debugging capabilities. While agent-browser provides low-level CDP interfaces, there is a lack of upper-layer visualization and auditing tools, making now the optimal time to enter the 'AgentOps' niche market.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅模式：基础版免费（限制每日会话数），专业版按月订阅（包含无限会话、高级风险检测及团队协作功能）。
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription model: Basic tier is free (limited daily sessions), Pro tier is monthly subscription (unlimited sessions, advanced risk detection, and team collaboration features).
